description: Sabre’s Red Crossfire Gel Pepper Spray is designed specifically for law enforcement professionals, offering superior target acquisition and reducing cross-contamination risks. Utilizing advanced Crossfire technology, this gel can be deployed from any angle, ensuring accuracy and effectiveness in high-pressure situations. The gel formula liquefies on contact, enhancing precision and minimizing the chances of affecting bystanders. With 10% oleoresin capsicum and 2 million Scoville heat units, it delivers unparalleled defense. Available in two sizes, 1.5 ounces (MK-3) and 3 ounces (MK-4), the smaller canister deploys 6 1-second bursts while the larger provides 13 bursts. The spray has a range of 15-20 feet, allowing for safe distance engagement. It is non-flammable, compatible with electronic immobilization devices (EIDs), and ISO 9001:2008 certified. Not available for sale in NY, MA, WI, and HI. This item is subject to hazmat shipping restrictions and cannot be shipped via air freight.
